scope: First local render attempt for the real-scene robot-execution comparison
summary: The initial OpenCV renderer stopped before decoding because the local system Python had no cv2 module.
evidence: Python raised ModuleNotFoundError for cv2 before any output video was created.
The immutable attempt directory retains configuration, command, Git state, and a PARTIAL result.
lessons: A comparison renderer should use the already available FFmpeg and bundled Pillow runtime instead of assuming local OpenCV.
limitations: No media artifact was produced by this attempt.
next_actions: Replace frame-by-frame OpenCV composition with FFmpeg filters and Pillow-generated labels.
